title: Temporal carry attribution via reset/recompute control
question: Does q1→q2 performance depend on carrying post-q1 persistent state across the action boundary, rather than recomputing state from the original observations?
hypothesis: If temporal carry is load-bearing on the registered E2E-008 task, the normal PLM will exceed the reset/recompute control by at least 0.05 in held-out q2 accuracy and the paired composition-bootstrap 95% interval for normal-minus-reset will exclude zero.

arms.name: normal
arms.intervention: Use the trained residual-linear PLM exactly as E2E-008: carry the post-q1 outcome-gated state update into q2.
arms.acts_on: temporal carry across q1→q2 action boundary

arms.name: reset_recompute
arms.intervention: After q1 and its environment outcome/update are computed, discard the updated state and recompute state solely from the original observations with the same frozen model weights before q2.
arms.acts_on: temporal carry; recomputation is forbidden from receiving q1 outcome, verifier signal, action, or label

decision_rule.condition: all integrity gates pass; normal mean held-out q2 accuracy exceeds reset_recompute mean by >=0.05; paired composition-bootstrap 95% CI for normal-minus-reset excludes zero with lower bound > 0
decision_rule.licenses: bounded causal evidence that temporal carry across the q1→q2 action boundary contributes to performance on the registered E2E-008 synthetic task
decision_rule.does_not_license: learned semantic memory, learned addressing, learned operator discovery, real-world multimodal understanding, general scaling, or a claim that temporal carry is necessary outside this task

decision_rule.condition: all integrity gates pass; normal-minus-reset gap is <0.05 or the paired composition-bootstrap interval includes zero
decision_rule.licenses: the registered experiment does not support a load-bearing temporal-carry contribution under the preregistered materiality rule
decision_rule.does_not_license: a conclusion that persistence is useless generally; the result remains bounded to this synthetic E2E-008 task

decision_rule.condition: reset/recompute is not inferentially clean, including any use of q1 outcome/label/verifier information in recomputation or failure of paired intervention invariants
decision_rule.licenses: no temporal-carry inference; measurement is instrument-invalid

interpretation_order: E2E-008 benchmark identity and reference-stream equality
model/configuration identity and frozen-weight parameter count
paired evaluation reuse and zero training/evaluation overlap
intervention invariants: q1 equality and pre-q1/recomputed state identity
primary normal versus reset_recompute q2 accuracy
paired composition-bootstrap gap and decision rule
held_constant: E2E-008 benchmark generator and 12 held-out compositions
exact E2E-008 hidden_dim=64 residual-linear model architecture
same five training seeds, optimizer, learning rate, weight decay, 300 training steps and batch size 96
same trained weights are used for normal and reset_recompute within each seed
same evaluation episode objects are used by both arms within each seed
no post-run model selection, no benchmark modification, and no hyperparameter tuning
the reset recomputation receives only the original observations and frozen model weights
layer: L3 causal attribution follow-up on the registered E2E-008 mechanism
leakage_rules: evaluation compositions are exactly the E2E-008 held-out set and are not used for training
evaluation is generated after training from the registered per-seed evaluation RNG namespace
within each seed, normal and reset_recompute use the same Python episode objects
each observed evaluation fingerprint must exactly equal the registered E2E-008 fingerprint for that seed
training/evaluation semantic overlap must be zero for every seed
the recomputation function may access only original observation rows and frozen model parameters; no q1 outcome, q1 target, verifier target, action, or correctness flag may enter it
q1 prediction must be identical between arms within each episode
the recomputed state before q2 must be byte-identical to the state immediately before q1 under deterministic evaluation
no model selection or hyperparameter tuning is performed from the paired results
this experiment is an attribution follow-up on an existing held-out benchmark, not a fresh generalization test
